tickets.name: Tip-Off Call
tickets.note: Nets at Hawks, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Okongwu against Sharpe, and Okongwu has the springs tonight! Advantage Hawks for the opening bucket. Should Okongwu get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! Flemings is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Should the Nets grab the first possession, Sharpe is our trigger man! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Wizards at Thunder, because the first minute is where the money is! Sarr and Mara for the opening tip, and you could flip a quarter on it! That puts the Thunder on the front foot to get on the board first. If the tip goes the Wizards' way, Dybantsa is the guy we want letting it fly! One man, one bet: Dybantsa. Let's ride!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Knicks visiting Cavaliers, and we've got the opening possessions mapped out! Mobley versus Towns for the tip, and Mobley has owned that matchup in the circle! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Cavaliers to cash the first trip! Watson is the one we want finishing that first trip down the floor! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Watson. Let's go!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: It's Magic and Warriors, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! It starts with Carter against Green at center court, and our money says Carter gets up there first! Win that tip and the Magic are first in line to score. Richardson slips free on the opening set, and that's our man! Just one play in this game, and it's Richardson all the way!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Spurs at Trail Blazers. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! Wembanyama and Clingan meet in the circle, and Wembanyama has been winning these jumps all season long! That hands the Spurs the first possession, and that's half the battle! When the Spurs come down for the first time, Castle is the one we're watching! And if the Trail Blazers flip the script, Clingan is waiting right there to pounce! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
